severity_definitions.BLOCKER: Must fix before merge; dishonest validator, broken contract, or pattern that would silently regress production.
severity_definitions.CRITICAL: Must fix before merge; dangling FK, missing required artifact, paper-spec, or scope-creep without ADR.
severity_definitions.MAJOR: Strongly recommended fix before merge; degraded honesty, template drift, or missing cross-ref.
severity_definitions.MINOR: Recommended fix; partial coverage, edge case missed, fragile-but-working code.

findings.fix: (a) Downgrade status from Accepted → Proposed until at least one validator lands, OR (b) chunk spec by enforced-now vs. planned-Q3 and only mark enforced subset binding.

findings.summary: mergeStateStatus = DIRTY/CONFLICTING, statusCheckRollup = []
findings.rationale: Cannot be merged as-is; no CI evidence of even the JSON-tool validation claimed in test plan.
findings.fix: Rebase on dev, trigger spec-validation lane.

findings.summary: Every entry points to 'cargo run -p oya-dev-cli -- gate validate <name>' but gate subcommand has no matching subgates
findings.rationale: Will fail closed with 'unknown gate' — readers will assume enforcement exists.
findings.fix: Add status: planned|implemented field per invariant; CI should warn on planned count.

findings.summary: supersedes: [] despite demoting docs/standards/hyperscaler-best-practices.md
findings.rationale: Demotion + canonical-source replacement is soft supersession. Per [[no-silent-regression]] list explicitly so chain is queryable.
findings.fix: Add docs/standards/hyperscaler-best-practices.md under supersedes or partially_supersedes.

findings.summary: No ADR-0105 13-layer-enum linkage
findings.rationale: Invariants like INV-CELL-ISOLATION, INV-OUTBOX-PATTERN, INV-SAGA-COMPENSATION are layer-bearing rules but spec never names which of the 13 layers they apply to.
findings.fix: Add applies_to_layers: [...] per invariant.

findings.summary: applies_to_products rubric undocumented
findings.rationale: INV-IDEMPOTENCY lists 11 products; INV-MULTI-REGION-FAILOVER lists 5; ad-hoc reads.
findings.fix: Document the rubric somewhere.

findings.summary: Claims 'auto-merge enabled' but autoMergeRequest: null
findings.rationale: Audit row is incorrect.
findings.fix: Correct the audit row.

prs.title: spec(plan-schema) + ADR-0129 + oya-check-honest-claims: ChangeSet as canonical parallel unit

findings.summary: Workflow only runs cargo test against in-source fixtures; never invokes validate_honest_claims against live docs/specs/decisions tree
findings.rationale: Lane is green-by-construction; cannot fail on a real deferral phrase in production artifacts. Recurrence of [[pr82-dishonest-exit-gate]]. ADR (line 88) and PR summary already claim this is wired via 'oya-dev-cli gate validate honest-claims' but workflow does not call it.
findings.fix: Add CLI/integration binary (oya-dev-cli gate validate honest-claims) that walks repo; add CI step that runs it.

findings.summary: implementation_plan_contract.must_have[] adds 6 new fields while explicit_frontmatter_coverage still reads 150/150
findings.rationale: Fields: changeset_id, symbols, depends_on_changesets, parallel_safe_with_changesets, serialize_with_changesets, acceptance_status. None of 150 IPs ship the new fields in this PR — contract claim is dishonest the moment it merges.
findings.fix: Drop coverage claim to current real number, OR migrate IPs in same ChangeSet, OR mark fields should_have until follow-up CS converts them.

findings.summary: scan_version_bumps would flag ADR-0129 itself (lines 79, 17 contain v2, v3)
findings.rationale: With workflow gap above this is dormant; once validator is wired to scan real files, PR becomes self-rejecting.
findings.fix: Add allow-list for code-fenced examples OR <!-- honest-claims:allow --> marker; add integration test that runs validator against this repo's own ADR-0129.

findings.summary: 'ChangeSet as canonical parallel unit' is documentation + schema only
findings.rationale: No code in this PR reads depends_on_changesets[] / parallel_safe_with_changesets[] / serialize_with_changesets[]. No topological-sort/slice-selector implementation. ADR-0124 phase 2 (named consumer) not landed. Title overclaims.
findings.fix: Retitle to 'spec + schema groundwork' OR land slice-selector consumer in same ChangeSet.

findings.summary: Markers ' tbd', ' tba' rely on leading space
findings.rationale: Won't catch line-leading or punctuation-prefixed occurrences (TBD:, (TBD) handled, but \nTBD or >TBD missed).
findings.fix: Use word-boundary scan.

findings.summary: Phase numbers hardcoded to 2–5 + ii–iv
findings.rationale: phase 6, phase vi etc. silently pass.
findings.fix: Generate algorithmically (phase {n} for n>=2).

findings.summary: Text says 'the following four fields' but five fields follow
findings.rationale: changeset_id + 4 edge fields = 5 total.
findings.fix: Correct count to five.

findings.summary: 92-entry baseline suppresses every Scanner A finding → CI reports Scanner A: 0 violations
findings.rationale: CI run 25989502739 confirms 0 violations, directly contradicting PR description headline 'Scanner A catches 218 real violations on current tree.' Baseline-rubberstamp pattern indistinguishable from [[pr82-dishonest-exit-gate]].
findings.fix: (a) Shrink baseline to a documented, dated subset and let real violations fail, OR (b) rewrite PR claim to '0 violations after baseline-absorbing 218-entry legacy backlog' and add expected_violations: floor so baseline cannot silently grow.

findings.summary: New workflow not added to required_status_checks
findings.rationale: ADR-0125 calls it 'a required CI gate' and standards doc claims 'wired + tested'. A non-required gate cannot block merges; documentation overstates enforcement.
findings.fix: Add lane name to required_status_checks.contexts list, OR downgrade standards-doc row from 'wired + tested' to 'wired (not yet required)'.

findings.summary: crate_name_refs_in_line trailing-punctuation trim corrupts identifiers with underscore
findings.rationale: tail.trim_end_matches(|c| !c.is_alphanumeric()) strips trailing _; identifier like oya-check-foo_v2 truncates to oya-check-foo. Combined with search_from = abs_start + prefix.len() + tail.len().max(1), next iteration can re-scan inside previous match and produce duplicate/shifted reports.
findings.fix: Use word-boundary regex; add test for identifier-with-underscore parsing and two-refs-on-one-line.

findings.summary: Walks docs/decisions/ only (non-recursive read_dir)
findings.rationale: ADR-0125 says 'scans every ADR' without scoping to one directory. ADRs in docs/decisions/archive/ or superseded/ silently skipped.
findings.fix: Add recursive walk OR document one-line rationale for scope.

findings.summary: Walks .omc/plans/milestones/ only
findings.rationale: F-IP-AC-BACKFILL-CORPUS says '202 IPs missing' across corpus. If IPs live anywhere else (.omc/plans/foundry/**, specs/**/IP-*.md) silently ignored — lane green while corpus broken.
findings.fix: Document path scope in ADR-0125 §Implementation OR widen the walk.

findings.summary: Scanner D unwrap_or(&format!(...)) constructs String temporary
findings.rationale: Compiles via temporary lifetime extension but fragile.
findings.fix: Use unwrap_or_else(|| format!(...).as_str()) with owned binding OR compute primitive_name as String directly.

findings.summary: Tests `indoc` helper only strips leading newline (no dedent)
findings.rationale: Comment claims 'minimal indoc-like helper'; misleading name.
findings.fix: Rename to lstrip_nl OR implement dedent.

findings.summary: read_file_string duplicates read_file
findings.rationale: Dead-code duplication.
findings.fix: Inline-delete one.
